title: Scope and Frequency of Safety Inspections on MRT Train Operators
what_it_is: Scope and Frequency of Safety Inspections on MRT Train Operators

sections.label: MOM workplace inspection regime
sections.summary: MOM conducts about 16,000 inspections yearly, targeting higher-risk workplaces, using a three-step procedure and issuing penalties for non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To ensure compliance and uncover unsafe practices for better deterrence, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) conducts about 16,000 inspections every year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, due to the large number of workplaces in Singapore to inspect, MOM has to take a targeted and risk-based approach in our inspection regime.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We focus our inspections on workplaces with higher risk activities, greater safety concerns and the types of workplaces that have a higher number of injuries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We do not go around and tell people we are going to inspect you when and how.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, for some inspections, such as the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) track operations and depots, inspections have to be pre-arranged.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A typical MOM inspection consists of a three-step procedure: (a) a site walk-through to assess the safety and health conditions of the workplace; (b) discussion with supervisors and workers on the operating procedures; and (c) review of the companies' key safety procedures and protocols.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Depending on the severity, we may issue Notices of Non-Compliances, Composition Fines or even Stop Work Orders.

sections.label: Track operations inspections after incident
sections.summary: Past inspections covered depots, offices, tracks, working at heights, chemicals and electrical issues; after the March 2016 incident, more inspections focus on track operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: In the past inspections, the MOM's team actually focused on many areas, including the safety protocols at the workplaces like depots, offices and also include tracks, and things like working at heights, storage of chemicals and some electrical issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: However, for track operations, they have been found to be quite safe and they did not have any track-related accidents in the last 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: That was the reply given to the Member's colleague, Assoc Prof Daniel Goh.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: However, after the March 2016 incident where it was found that the safety operating procedure was not followed strictly, we have stepped up more inspections to focus on this area.
